issues.problem: Explain said every verb ending in -aる/-uる/-oる is godan, but 来る (ku-ru) is irregular.
issues.action: Added 'apart from the irregular 来る'.

issues.problem: Mistake note called 来れる simply wrong; ら-dropping is widespread in casual speech, and the casual bad sentence made it look like a real error.
issues.action: Moved the pair to polite 来れますか / 来られますか and reworded the note: common in casual talk, non-standard in polite speech, writing and exams.

issues.problem: '先生から叱られた' was marked wrong, but から with 叱る (a speech act) is accepted by natives; the note even allowed verbs of saying.
issues.action: Replaced with 犬から噛まれた → 犬に噛まれた (physical act, where から really is wrong) and sharpened the note.

issues.problem: Possessive-passive mistake pair was not parallel (bad had 私の, good dropped the subject and context) and had no braces.
issues.action: Rewrote as 電車で私の足{が}踏まれた → 私は電車で足{を}踏まれた.

issues.problem: Example '息子に好きな大学に行かせた' had an awkward double に, and を=force / に=let was stated as an absolute rule.
issues.action: Reworded as a tendency and replaced the example with 息子に好きなだけ遊ばせた.

issues.problem: Bad sentence '部長が残業させられた' is grammatical (the manager was made to work overtime), so it is not a real error.
issues.action: Replaced with 私は部長{を}残業させられた → 私は部長{に}残業させられた and explained where を belongs.

issues.problem: Tip implied any される after an a-row sound is causative-passive, which misreads ordinary す-verb passives such as 話される.
issues.action: Rewrote the tip to warn that す-verbs and noun+する also form their passive with される.

issues.problem: Bad sentence '日本に行くと思う' is grammatical (I think I will go), so it is not a real error.
issues.action: Replaced with 行きましょうと思います → 行こうと思います, which really is wrong.

issues.problem: Bad '{いければ}、行きます' reads as valid 行ければ行きます (if I can go, I will go).
issues.action: Changed to 天気が{いければ}、出かけます → 天気が{よければ}、出かけます.

issues.problem: The English for よかったら、一緒に行きませんか was clumsy ('If you like, would you like to...').
issues.action: Changed to 'If you like, why not come along with us?'

issues.problem: Bad '映画を見たいじゃない。' can be read as a valid confirmation tag (I want to see a film, you know).
issues.action: Replaced with 見たいではありません → 見たくありません and added the polite negatives to the note.

issues.problem: Bad '～したりでした' is heard in colloquial speech (たりだ/たりです), so it is not clearly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced with し{たりました} → し{たりしました} and reworded the note.

issues.problem: Explain listed the pattern as '-su / -ru or -eru' while giving 起きる and 落ちる (-iru).
